description: Source code for INA230 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor data fetching, attribute setting/getting, calibration, and initialization.

methods.name: ina230_channel_get
methods.description: Fetches voltage, current, or power data from the INA230 sensor.

methods.name: ina230_sample_fetch
methods.description: Reads sensor data registers for voltage, current, and power.

methods.name: ina230_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as configuration, calibration, feature mask, and alert.

methods.name: ina230_calibrate
methods.description: Performs calibration of the INA230 sensor based on configuration.

methods.name: ina230_init
methods.description: Initializes the INA230 sensor, including configuration and calibration.
